stages.title: Straight lines
stages.instruction: Pull slow, straight lines along the guide. Move from your elbow, not your wrist.

stages.title: Waves
stages.instruction: Follow each wave in one smooth movement, without stopping halfway.

stages.title: Circles
stages.instruction: Trace each circle in a single stroke. Start small, then go bigger.

stages.title: Spiral
stages.instruction: Start at the centre and spiral outwards, keeping the gaps even.
